description:
Decentralized encrypted peer-to-peer mesh terminal chat client built with Python and Rust

BitChat RustPy is a decentralized, end-to-end encrypted peer-to-peer mesh chat application for the terminal operating over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and local area networks (LAN).
Built with Python and a native Rust core (_bitchat_core), it features authenticated Noise XX sessions, multi-hop mesh routing,
and an interactive Textual terminal user interface with no servers or accounts required.
- Phase 2.2 Authoritative Rust Protocol Engine: NativeNoiseSession, single-FFI NativeProtocolEngine (7.28x faster inbound DM pipeline, ~132x lower Python tracemalloc peak allocation), and Stage 3 NativePeerStateEngine
- Hardened Noise XX security: zero eager Python key copies (ZeroizeOnDrop in Rust), strict nonce-0 replay protection, fail-closed u32::MAX nonce exhaustion guard, and bounded pending DM queues (32/peer, 512 global)
- Controlled bitchat-tui interoperability with collision-safe post-authentication legacy peer-ID pinning, NoiseIdentityAnnounce (0x13), and DeliveryAck (0x0A)
- Single-pass authoritative Rust MeshRouter and StoreAndForwardQueue, native LAN IP rate limiter, and negotiated BLE ATT MTU write chunking
